name: Question 6
problem:
Consider the system of linear equations

$$
{\begin{aligned}x-2y=-1 \\ -4x+8y=7.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form, and then find the general solution of the linear system.

Question 6

Consider the system of linear equations {x−2y=−1−4x+8y=7. Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix M of the system to row echelon form, and then find the general solution of the linear system.

a
[xy]=[−2y−1y],y∈(−∞,∞)
b
No solution
c
[xy]=[2y−1y],y∈(−∞,∞)
d
[xy]=[1−2yy],y∈(−∞,∞)
e
[xy]=[2−yy],y∈(−∞,∞)
